Article element wrapping content preserves inner content

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<article><h2>Article Title</h2><p>Article body.</p></article>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
